## Change and mathematical scope

This independently reproduces Dugongue's T185 construction in #2863 and certifies a **tiny precision-only improvement to its explicit rational κ**. The circuit, allocation, paid profile, optimal moment root and inherited assumptions are unchanged. No new circuit, larger packing optimum or measured speedup is claimed.

Pinned comparison: #2863 at `34328b1d5e5bebac62d5cabec993dfbfd7b2123f`.

- Before: `0.001720100805416885927944 - 10^-46 - 10^-70`.
- After: `0.0017201008054168859279440070756063355312 - 10^-62 - 10^-86`.
- Exact gain: `7.07560633553120000009999999999999999000000009999999999999999e-27`.

The full rational, high-precision decimal, source manifests, proof argument, generators and release receipts are in research/t185-precision-replay. This does not update the reviewed selected record.

No original checker or manifest is weakened, and the original wrapper is not reported as passing unchanged.

Both requested main gates were run on untouched base: make verify fails historical singleton-target unpacking; make frontier1094-verify fails a historical proof-supplement hash. Logs are included. Frozen CRLF input bytes are intentionally retained despite git whitespace warnings.
